jobs.title: Frontend Developer Internship
jobs.description:
Responsibilities of the Intern:
Candidates need to work on front end of websites and apps
Collaborate with designers and engineers to create and maintain user interfaces for web and mobile applications.
Develop and implement front-end code using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.
Optimize website performance and ensure cross-browser compatibility.
Implement responsive design principles to ensure optimal user experience across devices.
Stay up-to-date with the latest front-end technologies and best practices.
Requirements:
Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React
Knowledge of user experience (UX) principles and best practices
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Passion for front-end development and a desire to learn and grow

jobs.title: Social Media Marketing Internship
jobs.description:
Responsibilities of the Intern:
Like, comment, and share content to increase reach and interaction
Help drive conversations and build an active online community
Identify and engage with relevant accounts, communities, and creators
Stay aligned with NGO values and audience interests
Contribute creative ideas that strengthen brand storytelling
Monitor engagement and analyze performance metrics
Share insights to improve content strategy and growth
Keep track of trending formats, sounds, and topics on social media
Help the team adapt trends that align with the NGO voice
Participate in weekly Sunday team meetings
Share ideas, updates, and creative feedback
Requirements:
Passion for social media, content creation, and storytelling
Curious and eager learner who enjoys experimenting
Team player open to feedback and collaboration
Motivated individual looking to make a real contribution
